title: SPS Commerce, Inc. 8-K — PSU Award Agreement Amendment
summary: SPS Commerce, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 disclosing amendments to its Performance Stock Unit (PSU) award agreements, effective April 10, 2026. The Compensation & Talent Committee standardized vesting provisions across outstanding PSU awards granted in 2024, 2025, and 2026 by converting all to double-trigger accelerated vesting upon a change in control.
key_points: SPS Commerce's Compensation & Talent Committee approved amendments to outstanding PSU awards effective April 10, 2026
2024 PSU grants were changed from single-trigger to double-trigger vesting upon a change in control
2025 and 2026 grants already had double-trigger provisions; now all PSU awards are standardized

Under double-trigger, accelerated vesting requires both a change in control AND termination without cause or resignation for good reason within one year, or if awards are not continued, assumed, or replaced by the surviving entity
For retired executives holding PSUs, vesting upon change in control equals the greater of target PSUs or actual performance during the truncated performance period
The amended Form of PSU Agreement (Exhibit 10.1) will also govern future PSU grants
Filing signed by Joseph Del Preto, Executive Vice President and CFO, dated April 14, 2026
